name: AgencyBoost Lite
author: shashank23jan

sections.description:
AgencyBoost Lite is the free version of AgencyBoost Pro – a complete AI-powered marketing suite for digital agencies.

Free features:

Lead Capture Popup
* Exit-intent trigger (fires when visitor moves mouse to close tab)
* Delay trigger (fires after X seconds)
* Scroll trigger (fires at 50% page scroll)
* Captures name, email and phone number
* Lead scoring – business emails and phone numbers score higher
* CSV export of all captured leads
* Admin email notification on every new lead
* CRM webhook – works with Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign

Analytics Tracking Injection
* Add GA4 tracking ID – injected automatically in site head
* No theme editing needed

Dashboard
* Lead count and monthly summary
* Popup status
* Setup checklist

Upgrade to Pro to unlock:
* AI Content Engine – generate AEO, GEO and E-E-A-T optimised content with 8 AI providers
* Keyword Intelligence – intent-based research, People Also Ask, content briefs
* GA4 Analytics Dashboard – real traffic data, charts, top pages
* Local SEO Schema – JSON-LD structured data for local search
* PDF Reports – white-label client reports with email delivery
* Email SMTP – SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo, Postmark, Amazon SES

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to the following third-party services. All services are only activated when the site owner explicitly enters their tracking ID or pixel ID in the plugin settings. No data is sent by default.

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

What it does: Tracks website visitors, sessions, page views and traffic sources.
What data is sent: Standard browser and session data (IP address, pages visited, referrer, device info) — sent on every page load when GA4 is enabled.
When: Only when a GA4 Measurement ID is entered in Settings > Analytics Setup.
Service provider: Google LLC
Terms of service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Tag Manager (GTM)

What it does: Loads and manages third-party tracking tags and scripts on the site.
What data is sent: Depends on tags configured in the GTM container. At minimum, the page URL and GTM container ID are sent on every page load.
When: Only when a GTM Container ID is entered in Settings > Analytics Setup.
Service provider: Google LLC
Terms of service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Microsoft Clarity

What it does: Records visitor sessions, heatmaps and click patterns to help site owners understand user behaviour.
What data is sent: Mouse movements, clicks, scroll depth, page URL and session data — sent on every page load when Clarity is enabled.
When: Only when a Microsoft Clarity Project ID is entered in Settings > Analytics Setup.
Service provider: Microsoft Corporation
Terms of service: https://clarity.microsoft.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel)

What it does: Tracks conversions, builds retargeting audiences and measures ad effectiveness on Meta platforms.
What data is sent: Page views, browser data, hashed user identifiers (if available) and custom events — sent on every page load when Meta Pixel is enabled.
When: Only when a Meta Pixel ID is entered in Settings > Analytics Setup.
Service provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
Terms of service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

TikTok Pixel

What it does: Tracks website events for TikTok ad campaign measurement and audience building.
What data is sent: Page views, browser and device data — sent on every page load when TikTok Pixel is enabled.
When: Only when a TikTok Pixel ID is entered in Settings > Analytics Setup.
Service provider: TikTok Inc.
Terms of service: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/terms-of-service/en
Privacy policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/privacy-policy/en

Hotjar

What it does: Records visitor sessions and generates heatmaps to help analyse user experience.
What data is sent: Mouse movements, clicks, scroll behaviour, page URL and session data — sent on every page load when Hotjar is enabled.
When: Only when a Hotjar Site ID is entered in Settings > Analytics Setup.
Service provider: Hotjar Ltd.
Terms of service: https://www.hotjar.com/legal/policies/terms-of-service/
Privacy policy: https://www.hotjar.com/legal/policies/privacy/

Important: None of these services are activated by default. The site owner must explicitly enter their own account credentials (Tracking ID, Pixel ID, etc.) in the plugin settings to enable them. It is the site owner’s responsibility to obtain user consent in accordance with applicable laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) before enabling any tracking service.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > search for AgencyBoost
  2. Install and activate
  3. Go to AgencyBoost > Lead Capture
  4. Set your popup title, subtitle and button text
  5. Toggle Enable popup ON
  6. Save settings
  7. Visit your website – move mouse to top of browser to trigger exit intent popup
sections.faq:
Is this really free with no limits?

Yes. Lead capture and GA4 injection are completely free with no usage limits.

Where are leads stored?

All leads are stored in your own WordPress database. Nothing is sent to our servers.

How does lead scoring work?

Leads with business email addresses (not Gmail/Yahoo/Hotmail) score 30 points higher. Leads with phone numbers score 20 points higher. This helps you prioritise follow-ups.

Can I connect it to my CRM?

Yes. Paste your Zapier, Make or any webhook URL in the CRM integration field. Every lead is instantly sent to your CRM with name, email, phone and page URL.

What is the Pro version?

AgencyBoost Pro adds AI content generation, keyword research, GA4 analytics dashboard, local SEO schema, PDF client reports and email SMTP. See d3experts.in/agencyboost for details.
